hypothesis: baseline
Bind named envelope dims (width/depth/height|thick|plate_t, or radius/outer_r+height) so the solid scales with parameters instead of a frozen bbox.
When the only extra param is hole_d, cut a centered through-hole so plate volume tracks hole_d without touching offset/pattern/cbore families.
When the only extra param on an outer_r+height cylinder is inner_r, cut a centered through-hole of diameter 2*inner_r so the tube volume tracks inner_r.
When the only extras on a width/depth/plate_t box are boss_d and boss_h, extrude a centered cylinder so Z extent and volume track the boss.
When extras are hole_d+hole_x+hole_y, cut a through-hole offset by hole_x/hole_y so volume and centroid track the offset hole.
When extras are boss_d+boss_h+boss_x+boss_y, extrude a cylinder offset by boss_x/boss_y so volume, Z extent, and centroid track the offset boss.
When extras are hole_d+cbore_d+cbore_h, cut a centered counterbore so plate volume tracks the through-hole and the shallow cbore pocket.
When the only extra param on a width/depth/height box is fillet_r, fillet all edges so volume and extents track the blend radius.
When the only extra param on a width/depth/height box is chamfer, chamfer all edges so volume and extents track the bevel size.
When extras are slot_l+slot_w, cut a centered through-slot so plate volume tracks the slot length and width.
When extras are hole_d+pitch, cut two through-holes on the X-axis at ±pitch/2 so plate volume tracks a two-hole pattern instead of a single centered hole.
When the only extra param on a width/depth/height box is chamfer, chamfer only the top-face edges so volume and Z-centroid track a top break (not all-edge chamfer, which was discarded).
When extras are hole_d+pitch_x+pitch_y, cut a 2x2 through-hole grid at (±pitch_x/2, ±pitch_y/2) so plate volume tracks a rectangular bolt pattern instead of a solid box.
When extras are slot_l+slot_w+slot_x+slot_y, cut a through-slot offset by slot_x/slot_y so volume and centroid track the offset slot.
When extras are hole_d+cbore_d+cbore_h+hole_x+hole_y, cut an offset counterbore so volume and centroid track a shifted cbore instead of a solid box.
Bind length/width (or length/depth) and thickness as envelope aliases so plates named that way scale with parameters instead of a frozen bbox.
When extras are only thick on a width/depth/height box, shell inward from the top face so wall thickness tracks thick (open tray) instead of a solid box.
When extras are hole_d+hole_h, cut a centered blind hole of depth hole_h so plate volume tracks a stopped bore instead of a through-hole or solid box.
Extrude radius/outer_r cylinders from the XY plane (z=0..height) instead of the centered cylinder primitive so the Z-centroid matches the observed family.
When extras are hole_d+csk_d+csk_angle, cut a centered countersink so plate volume tracks the through-hole and the conical csk instead of a solid box.
